author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Raptor head in profile: hooked beak with a hook tip on the left edge, face line from forehead to gape, domed crown into the back of the neck, S-shaped throat and a shoulder curve, all from the reference. Dot eye. No close Lucide match (Lucide bird is a full body); smooth cubic construction.
omissions: Brow line over the eye and the eye ring reduced to a dot (no 8-unit room between the face line and the crown).
